To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the magnetic properties of Vitroperm 800 can be improved by mechanical treatment, which is an alternative to annealing, and can be further tailored by warm consolidation.
we have developed a new method of preparation of the Fe-based bulk magnetic materials with high permeability, high electrical resistivity, and high magnetic saturation.
the soft magnetic properties of the Fe-based compacts can be improved by annealing at higher temperatures.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new materials with soft magnetic properties.
the preparation of bulk samples of Fe-based soft magnetic materials with low core losses and high permeability.
the development of a new class of soft magnetic bulk materials with a low coercivity and low core loss.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the magnetic properties of the Fe-based compacts were improved by milling, and the magnetic properties of as-prepared and annealed samples are similar to that of the Vitroperm 800 ribbon.
the magnetic properties of the Vitroperm 800 are similar to that of the Co-based amorphous alloys and can be used for high frequency applications.
the magnetic properties of Vitroperm 800 alloy are very promising for applications in the frequency range of 50-500 kHz.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the magnetic properties of the as-preared powder samples are similar to the amorphous ribbons and the magnetic properties of warm-consolidated compacts depend on the consolidation pressure and annealing temperature.
the magnetic properties of Vitroperm powder cores are comparable with the properties of Co-based cores.
the soft magnetic properties of the Fe-based alloy powder compacts are very similar to that of Co-based compacts, but the coercivity of the Fe-based compacts is higher than the Co-based ones.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the magnetic properties of the compacts prepared from amorphous Vitroperm alloy are comparable to those of Co-based compacts and are suitable for applications where the soft magnetic materials are used.
it is possible to prepare soft magnetic bulk samples with coercivities down to 13–14 A/m, and with low losses at 100 Hz and 1 T, which is comparable to that of Co-based materials.
the magnetic properties of the compacts can be tuned by varying milling parameters.
